objective: Define the smallest direct native-Verilator command-path boundary after accepting the scoped sidecar execution run, while keeping this gate definition-only and avoiding native option support, direct command execution, timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality claims.

reason: the previous review accepted the scoped sidecar build/run/compare result but explicitly rejected treating run_hybrid_template.py as a direct native Verilator invocation
the narrowest remaining usability gap is how a future Verilator-owned option path produces the same reviewed sidecar stage plan and generated evidence boundaries
the boundary must preserve ordinary Verilator inputs without inferring arbitrary source closure or automatic GPU allocation
the boundary must remain inspectable through dry-run or preflight before any direct command execution is allowed
definition_decision.weakest_point: A direct-looking command can be over-read as executed native support. This definition therefore chooses only a command-path boundary: native options may produce a structured sidecar command plan after review, but this gate does not execute Verilator, run RTL, compare outputs, measure timing, change runtime/ABI, infer arbitrary filelist dependencies, or allocate GPU work automatically.

direct_command_path_boundary.direct_command_route: native parser values must materialize or reference a structured sidecar stage plan before any execution authority
direct_command_path_boundary.wrapper_invocation_status: existing wrapper/template commands are compatibility evidence and implementation fallback, not proof of native direct command support
direct_command_path_boundary.intermediate_operator_plan_status: allowed as reviewable metadata only; command_argv is not runtime authority by itself
direct_command_path_boundary.coverage_policy_status: later compare policy only, not evidence from this definition gate

responsibilities: parse the expanded sidecar-gpu option spelling
validate state_count and step_count as positive integers
preserve ordinary Verilator build inputs and their ordering where that matters to Verilator
emit a reviewable structured payload or plan reference instead of relying on scraped human command strings
fail closed before execution when required shape or build inputs are missing

sidecar_owned_fields.generated_evidence_policy: reports/ and artifacts/ are generated evidence only and never source of truth
sidecar_owned_fields.source_closure_policy: parser-preserved source_files and filelists are build inputs only until a reviewed sidecar source boundary resolves closure

closed_or_deferred_surfaces.target_first_registry_lookup: sidecar wrapper convenience, not native parser responsibility
closed_or_deferred_surfaces.resident_modes: not ready for direct native command execution by this definition
closed_or_deferred_surfaces.dataset_backed_mobile_vit: not ready for direct native command execution by this definition
closed_or_deferred_surfaces.arbitrary_filelists: deferred until source-closure authority is separately defined
closed_or_deferred_surfaces.automatic_gpu_allocation: deferred until allocation-policy execution is separately defined

required_tests_for_next_review: the definition uses the sidecar execution run review gate as its source artifact
the minimum native spelling is the expanded --sim-accel sidecar-gpu plus --sim-accel-states/--sim-accel-steps form
the boundary chooses structured sidecar plan materialization before execution authority
command_argv and operator-plan metadata remain reviewable metadata rather than runtime authority
parser-owned preserved source files and filelists are not source-closure authority
sidecar-owned stage order and generated evidence policy are required before execution
coverage_output_equivalence remains a later compare policy, not evidence from this definition
this gate forbids direct execution, timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, and raw full-state equality claims

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the expanded Verilator-facing spelling is the correct minimum native command path
whether structured sidecar plan materialization is the right boundary before execution
whether parser-owned and sidecar-owned fields are separated tightly enough
whether dry-run or preflight is sufficient as the next proof surface before another run
whether compact shape spelling, estimate-efficiency, resident modes, dataset-backed flows, arbitrary filelists, and automatic allocation remain deferred
whether the next work should implement a non-executing direct-command fixture or refine the definition
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow

non_claims: not native Verilator parser implementation completion
not coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow
not source-closure or filelist dependency inference
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
